title: Skate game built in unity with an ai game dev framework tool that I've been building! You can add a feature easily!
author: Brave-History-6502
selftext:
I am a huge fan of games like skater xl, skate, the original THPS franchise, thrasher, etc. I've been trying to recreate some of the magic of those games over the years with ai. This last batch of models finally got me to a place where i think it is worth sharing!

I used this tool I've been building that I'm hoping can be a community/collective tool for collaborating on game dev.

Link: [https://play.gamecrew.ai/t/\_yX3eFb2AFsFALupAfIGTSHFuN8-IB\_d/](https://play.gamecrew.ai/t/_yX3eFb2AFsFALupAfIGTSHFuN8-IB_d/)

The thing that I'm most excited about is create an ability for people to user their own agents to add features or ideas to game ideas like this!

The platform supports this in beta for a limited number of spots right now....I have to balance it since it is using compute that I pay for since I need to run tests via unity to ensure the changes compile/pass smoke tests etc.  
  
If you want to add on you can create a branch and merge request into the main game if you want and if it looks stable I will approve! Still trying to figure out the right balance here since ideally I could just open up things even more to reduce barriers to adding on ideas etc.

**How to add an idea/change request:**

1. In Claude or ChatGPT, add a custom connector with this address: [https://play.gamecrew.ai/mcp](https://play.gamecrew.ai/mcp)

2. Sign in with Google and press Connect.

3. Tell your assistant something like: "Read [https://play.gamecrew.ai/agents.md](https://play.gamecrew.ai/agents.md), then add a grind rail to Kerbside and open a merge request."

You get a link to play your version. If I like your change, I merge it into the game.

Under the hood it is using a set of tools/skills, and sub agents primarily running on an opus 5.5 game director delegating to sub agents that are specialized, along with asset generation pipelines that plugin into apis like meshy, tripo, elevenlabs etc.
